newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 24.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Over 1,000 doctors to demonstrate on Tuesday outside parliament to demand right to dispense medicine
Former American Institute in Taiwan chairman James Wood alleges that AIT travel service section employee raped visa applicants, sold visas at high prices
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Ex-AIT chief Wood accuses AIT of lawbreaking and corruption
LIBERTY TIMES - Former AIT chief hits back, saying he was purged by State Department and forced to step down because of his investigation of irregularities in AIT Taipei operation
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Council for Economic Planning and Development to invite government department heads to discuss further relaxation for foreigners to invest in Taiwan industries, services
Transport ministry to set up cross-department committee to map out new navigation, shipping policies
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Finance ministry seizes opportunity of stock rise to sell 40 million shares, including popular Cathay Insurance, given to tax deparments as tax payment
U.S. dollar component of Taiwan foreign exchange reserves rises to 60 percent, highest in five years
